title: Automated venture troubleshooting: walker captures cause with provenance, CI provisions bindings
goal_summary: Stage-23 walker attaches provenanced captured_cause (Worker logs, venture_errors, D1 failures) to every failed journey; altifyai Deploy fails loud on missing secrets; chairman never reads a log or sets a secret by hand.
executive_summary: Automate AltifyAI venture troubleshooting per ratification 1afdeaac: the stage-23 walker attaches provenanced captured_cause to every failed journey, altifyai CI provisions/verifies bindings and fails loud, replacing a manual log-read + secret-provision step.

functional_requirements.requirement: The stage-23 journey walk (lib/apa/journey-walk-orchestrator.js) attaches captured_cause to every failed step's uat_test_results.metadata, with a summary rollup folded into strategic_directives_v2.metadata.journey_walk_result.captured_cause
functional_requirements.description: captured_cause = {window:{from,to}, worker_logs:LEG, venture_errors:LEG, d1_failures:LEG, summary}. LEG = {producer, run_id, content_hash, item_count, items[], items_truncated, absent, absent_reason}. worker_logs is fetched via the Cloudflare Workers Observability telemetry query API (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID env, same credential contract as lib/operator/cloudflare-cost-adapter.js) for the journey step's time window; venture_errors is read from public.feedback WHERE venture_id=$1 AND feedback_type='venture_error' AND last_seen BETWEEN $2 AND $3 (existing idx_feedback_venture_error_created index); d1_failures is read from the venture's Cloudflare D1 generated_alt_texts table (failure_code, failure_detail, created_at) via the D1 HTTP API, resolving database_id at runtime via Cloudflare's list-D1-databases API matched against the venture's workers.dev subdomain slug (no stored database_id exists in ventures.metadata). run_id/content_hash are required non-null whenever absent===false (ratification 6c263823: evidence without provenance is absent). Total captured_cause JSON is bounded to ~8KB (10 items/leg, 200 chars/item post-redaction) with a JSON.stringify().length backstop. Two named injectable seams on runVentureJourneyWalk: deps.captureCloudflareLogs and deps.queryVentureD1 (deps.queryVentureErrors already resolvable via existing Supabase client), so unit tests fixture all three legs without live network calls.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A forced-failing stage-23 journey step (fixture failure) produces a uat_test_results row whose metadata.captured_cause.worker_logs/venture_errors/d1_failures each carry non-null producer+run_id+content_hash when absent===false

AC-2: When a leg genuinely returns zero matching rows (item_count=0, absent=false), the rendered summary reads '<leg>: no matching entries in window (capture succeeded)' — never conflated with absent=true's 'capture unavailable (<absent_reason>)'
AC-3: strategic_directives_v2.metadata.journey_walk_result.captured_cause is populated only when status='fail' and brokenAtStep is set, via the existing stampJourneyWalkResult() merge point

functional_requirements.requirement: The altifyai Deploy workflow (rickfelix/altifyai .github/workflows/deploy.yml) runs an idempotent secret-provisioning step for EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_URL, EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VENTURE_ID and fails the run loud when any GitHub secret is absent
functional_requirements.description: Reuses the existing one-shot-secret-provision.yml (altifyai PR #90) loop byte-identically inside deploy.yml — same per-secret empty-value check emitting ::error:: and exit 1, same idempotent `wrangler secret put` — placed as a new step immediately after 'Deploy to Cloudflare'. No new provisioning logic is authored; this FR only wires the already-shipped, already-tested loop into the always-run Deploy path so forwarding secrets are never silently unprovisioned in production (per the venture doc's own finding that they are 'currently dormant in production').
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Deploying with one of the three GitHub secrets unset fails the workflow at the new provisioning step with the ::error:: line naming the missing secret, before the deploy is considered complete
AC-2: Deploying with all three secrets set succeeds and `wrangler secret list --name altifyai` (already part of the reused step) shows all three present in the step summary
AC-3: Re-running Deploy with unchanged secrets is a no-op (idempotent `wrangler secret put` behavior, unchanged from PR #90)

functional_requirements.requirement: A CI step in the altifyai repo verifies the Cloudflare deploy token reaches Workers AI (/ai/run) and observability read; on a missing scope it emits exactly one named chairman keystroke and never a log-reading instruction
functional_requirements.description: Extends the existing one-shot-ai-probe.yml (PR #92, which already measured a 401 from the Deploy token lacking Workers AI scope) into a Deploy-path CI step. On success: silent pass. On a 401/403 from either probe: one ::error:: line in the exact format 'Cloudflare token is missing permission "<capability>" — add it at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens (edit the Deploy token, add the scope, save)' — <capability> is the literal Cloudflare permission-group name for the failing probe (Workers AI Read for /ai/run, Logs Read for observability), never a placeholder token name since it is not retrievable from CI, and never an instruction to read a dashboard or log stream.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: With the current under-scoped token, the CI step emits the single named-keystroke line and fails the run; the line names one concrete permission to add, nothing else
AC-2: With a correctly-scoped token (test fixture / mocked HTTP 200 responses), the step passes silently with no chairman-facing output
AC-3: The step never emits a wrangler tail command, a dashboard URL for log reading, or any instruction requiring the chairman to interpret raw logs

functional_requirements.requirement: altifyai lib/error-capture/capture.js emits console.error (not console.warn) when forwarding is disabled due to missing env, and the warn-once latch correctly suppresses repeats within one isolate
functional_requirements.description: REDUCED AT LEAD from the original scope: the composeFailureDetail redacted-message-prefix half is CUT because it collides with pinned security tests TS-10/TS-12 in altifyai tests/alt-text-generate.test.js (failure_detail is pinned to carry zero provider message text) — an unresolved spec-conflict signal (b9787bf4) already exists for this and PLAN does not reopen it; diagnosis for that path travels through FR-1's D1 capture instead. This FR is scoped to capture.js's checkEnv() path only (lines ~13-28): the three console.warn calls (missing-env, unparseable-response, record_venture_error-failure-reported, forward-attempt-threw) become console.error so a bounded wrangler-tail window during a repro (one-shot-wrangler-tail.yml) surfaces the failure. The warn-once latch (module-level warnedMissingEnv) is preserved but its existing test gap is closed: altifyai tests/error-capture.test.js TS-9 currently calls captureError() only once and never proves the latch suppresses a second call.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A missing-env forward attempt emits console.error (not console.warn) with the existing message text unchanged

AC-2: A second captureError() call within the same isolate after a missing-env failure emits no further console output (latch holds) — a NEW test proves this by calling captureError() twice and asserting exactly one console.error invocation
AC-3: composeFailureDetail in lib/alt-text/generate.js is NOT modified by this SD; TS-10/TS-12 continue to pass unchanged

functional_requirements.requirement: The walk result's captured_cause and the completion-ready probe surface the diagnosis in the AltifyAI status line consumed by scripts/adam-exec-summary.mjs and scripts/adam-decision-email.mjs, without altering venture-build-status.mjs's closed BUILD_STATUS enum
functional_requirements.description: New pure function formatCauseLine(captured_cause) renders a single ASCII line ≤160 chars: 'cause: <summary> (<producer>, <run_id-short>)' for a real cause, or the three-state absent/empty renderings from FR-1's AC-2. cause is an ADDITIVE sibling key returned alongside deriveVentureBuildStatus()'s existing BUILD_STATUS output — never a new enum value — populated only in the IO wrapper that already joins ventures+venture_deployments, using the existing metadata->>venture_id lookup pattern from lib/eva/quality-findings/db-sourced-findings.js (not the incompletely-backfilled top-level venture_id FK). lib/fleet/parent-completion.mjs re-fetches parent.metadata fresh immediately after its runHandoff('PLAN-TO-LEAD', ...) call resolves (not the pre-handoff parent object) and appends the cause line to its returned message, fail-soft (a fetch error never blocks the completion-ready computation itself).
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: adam-exec-summary.mjs's plain-text and HTML-escaped render paths both show the cause line for a venture with a captured RED walk, with no markdown and no line break inside the 160-char budget
AC-2: deriveVentureBuildStatus()'s BUILD_STATUS enum value is byte-identical before and after this change for every existing fixture (additive-only regression test)

AC-3: parent-completion.mjs's countCompletionReadyParents() output includes the cause line for a parent SD whose child carries a failed journey_walk_result, verified by a re-fetch (not the stale pre-handoff object) in a unit test

functional_requirements.requirement: altifyai docs/usage-event-ingest-secret-provisioning.md's 'human step' section is rewritten to describe the CI path built by FR-2/FR-3, removing the now-inaccurate 'why this is a human step' framing
functional_requirements.description: The doc already partially refutes its own premise (Option B was described before it was built); this FR closes the loop by replacing the 'human step' heading and its rationale with a description of the automated Deploy-time provisioning (FR-2) and token-scope verification (FR-3), retaining only the genuinely one-time steps that remain human (minting the initial ingest key via fn_provision_venture_ingest_key) as an explicitly-labeled bootstrap step, not a recurring troubleshooting step.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The rewritten section no longer instructs a human to run `wrangler secret put` locally as the primary path
AC-2: The section names FR-2's Deploy-time provisioning and FR-3's token-scope check as the enforced mechanism
AC-3: The one genuinely-human bootstrap step (initial key minting) is clearly labeled as one-time, not recurring troubleshooting

technical_requirements.requirement: runVentureJourneyWalk (lib/apa/journey-walk-orchestrator.js) accepts two new optional injectable deps: deps.captureCloudflareLogs(ventureId, window) and deps.queryVentureD1(ventureId, table, window), both defaulting to real Cloudflare API implementations but overridable in tests
technical_requirements.rationale: TESTING evidence (45f25a18, blocking finding B2) confirmed zero existing callable client exists in EHG_Engineer for Cloudflare Worker log tail or D1 reads; without named injectable seams, EXEC cannot write real code or PLAN cannot spec provable unit tests, and the provenance-forgery risk (RISK evidence 0ec29338 R4) is unmitigated if the walker both dispatches and authors its own gating evidence.

technical_requirements.requirement: All captured_cause content passes through the existing altifyai redaction module pattern (composeFailureDetail's allowlist-only assembly: provider_status;provider_code;classification) before storage — no raw provider message text, headers, or request bodies are persisted in uat_test_results.metadata or the feedback table
technical_requirements.rationale: RISK evidence 0ec29338 (R2, hard EXEC-completion gate): the altifyai redaction module is scoped to app-error shape, not raw wrangler-tail output, and uat_test_results.metadata has no DB-level size or content cap; shipping without a redaction-coverage test risks leaking secrets or PII into an evidence row that downstream gates and Adam's status line both read.

technical_requirements.requirement: The Cloudflare API credential used by the walker is read once at construction from CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (fleet-wide env, same contract as lib/operator/cloudflare-cost-adapter.js), never a per-venture credential stored in ventures.metadata
technical_requirements.rationale: DATABASE evidence (0d33d5d5) confirmed no venture row carries a Cloudflare account_id or D1 database_id in metadata across all 56 distinct top-level keys fleet-wide; the D1 database_id must be resolved live via Cloudflare's list-D1-databases API matched by database_name against the venture's workers.dev subdomain, since wrangler.toml commits only a placeholder id.

technical_requirements.requirement: The altifyai Deploy workflow changes (FR-2/FR-3) and the doc rewrite (FR-6) ship as one PR in rickfelix/altifyai branched from a fresh pull of origin/main (140e971 or newer); EHG_Engineer changes (FR-1/FR-5) ship as a separate PR in this repo; the altifyai PR URL is attached as EXEC evidence on the EHG_Engineer SD since this repo's gate pipeline has no visibility into the altifyai repo
technical_requirements.rationale: VALIDATION evidence (CONDITIONAL_PASS 90) confirmed both local altifyai checkouts are 73-132 commits behind origin/main with an unrelated uncommitted feature in one working tree; building on the stale checkout risks silent conflicts with PRs #90-#94 already merged there.

system_architecture.overview: Two independently-deployed halves connected by a shared, versioned captured_cause data contract. In EHG_Engineer, the existing stage-23 journey walk pipeline (lib/apa -> lib/uat/result-recorder.js -> uat_test_results/uat_test_runs -> strategic_directives_v2.metadata.journey_walk_result) gains a new evidence-attachment step that queries three independent sources per failed step and writes a bounded, provenanced object. In the altifyai Cloudflare Worker repo, the Deploy workflow gains a fail-loud provisioning step and a token-scope probe, and the error-capture module's silent-failure path becomes observable during a bounded tail window. Neither half depends on the other at runtime; they are connected only by the data the walker reads (venture_errors via the already-shipped record_venture_error RPC, D1 failures via the venture's own database) and by CI evidence attachment (the altifyai PR URL referenced from the EHG_Engineer SD).

components.name: captureCloudflareLogs (new)
components.responsibility: Query the Cloudflare Workers Observability telemetry API for a bounded journey-window log slice for the AltifyAI worker; returns a LEG object with provenance or absent+reason

components.name: queryVentureD1 (new)
components.responsibility: Resolve the venture's D1 database_id live via Cloudflare's list-D1-databases API, then query generated_alt_texts for failure rows in the journey window

components.name: queryVentureErrors (reuses existing Supabase client)
components.responsibility: Read public.feedback rows written by record_venture_error for the venture in the journey window

components.name: journey-walk-orchestrator.js (modified)
components.responsibility: Orchestrates the three capture calls per failed step, assembles the bounded captured_cause object, folds a summary into the SD-level journey_walk_result rollup

components.name: formatCauseLine (new)
components.responsibility: Pure function rendering captured_cause into the single-line ASCII status-line string with three-state (absent/empty/populated) handling

components.name: deploy.yml secret-provisioning step (new, altifyai)
components.responsibility: Reuses PR #90's idempotent wrangler secret put loop as a Deploy-path step; fails loud on a missing GitHub secret

components.name: deploy.yml token-scope probe (new, altifyai)
components.responsibility: Reuses PR #92's Workers AI probe shape plus an observability-read probe; emits one named keystroke on a missing scope

components.name: capture.js checkEnv() (modified, altifyai)
components.responsibility: Switches console.warn to console.error on the forwarding-disabled path, latch behavior unchanged

system_architecture.data_flow: Journey step fails -> journey-walk-orchestrator.js calls the three capture functions in parallel with the step's time window -> each returns a LEG (data + provenance, or absent) -> assembled into captured_cause, redacted, size-bounded -> written to uat_test_results.metadata.captured_cause via the existing recordResult() call -> on walk completion, summary folded into strategic_directives_v2.metadata.journey_walk_result.captured_cause via the existing stampJourneyWalkResult() merge -> downstream: (a) venture-build-status.mjs's IO wrapper reads the SD row and adds the additive `cause` field, consumed by adam-exec-summary.mjs/adam-decision-email.mjs; (b) parent-completion.mjs re-reads parent.metadata post-handoff and appends the cause line. In altifyai: a GitHub Actions push to main triggers deploy.yml -> D1 migrations -> wrangler deploy -> [NEW] secret-provisioning step (fail loud if a GitHub secret is absent) -> [NEW] token-scope probe (fail with one named keystroke if a scope is missing) -> existing post-deploy-signed-in-uat step.
integration_points: lib/uat/result-recorder.js recordResult() — existing insertion point for captured_cause, no signature change (metadata is already a passthrough jsonb param)
public.feedback / record_venture_error RPC (existing, unmodified) — read-only consumer relationship
Cloudflare Workers Observability API and D1 HTTP API — new external dependencies, credentialed via existing fleet-wide CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID

scripts/modules/handoff/executors/plan-to-lead/gates/prerequisite-check.js and lib/eva/quality-findings/db-sourced-findings.js — existing unmodified consumers of journey_walk_result.status; captured_cause is an additive field they may optionally surface later, not a required read for this SD
GitHub Actions in rickfelix/altifyai — deploy.yml gains two new steps; one-shot-secret-provision.yml and one-shot-ai-probe.yml logic is reused, not duplicated as new modules

test_scenarios.scenario: Forced-failing stage-23 journey step produces captured_cause with full provenance on all three legs
test_scenarios.given: runVentureJourneyWalk is invoked with fixture deps.captureCloudflareLogs/queryVentureD1/queryVentureErrors each returning a populated LEG with producer+run_id+content_hash, and a journey step configured to fail
test_scenarios.when: the walk executes and the failed step is recorded
test_scenarios.then: the resulting uat_test_results row's metadata.captured_cause has all three legs with absent=false and non-null producer/run_id/content_hash, and the SD-level journey_walk_result.captured_cause carries the summary

test_scenarios.scenario: An empty-but-successful capture never reads as 'no cause'
test_scenarios.given: all three fixture deps return absent=false with item_count=0
test_scenarios.then: the output text is '...no matching entries in window (capture succeeded)...' and is textually distinct from the absent=true rendering, per RISK finding R3 (empty-capture-reads-as-no-cause)

test_scenarios.scenario: A capture that could not run at all is distinguishable from an empty one
test_scenarios.given: deps.captureCloudflareLogs throws / times out for the journey window
test_scenarios.then: worker_logs.absent=true with absent_reason='fetch_failed' (not item_count=0), and formatCauseLine() renders 'capture unavailable (fetch_failed)'

test_scenarios.scenario: captured_cause respects the ~8KB size bound under a worst-case fixture
test_scenarios.given: each of the three fixture legs returns the maximum 10 items at 200 chars each
test_scenarios.when: the walker assembles and serializes captured_cause
test_scenarios.then: JSON.stringify(captured_cause).length stays under the documented backstop and items_truncated is set on any leg that exceeded the per-leg cap

test_scenarios.scenario: altifyai Deploy fails loud when a forwarding secret is missing
test_scenarios.given: a workflow-lint or extracted-shell-script test harness invokes the secret-provisioning step's logic with one of EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_URL/EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY/VENTURE_ID unset
test_scenarios.then: it exits non-zero with an ::error:: line naming the missing secret, matching the exit predicate from Solomon c2cba209 ('Deploy run fails when a forwarding secret is missing')

test_scenarios.scenario: altifyai Deploy succeeds and is idempotent when all forwarding secrets are present
test_scenarios.given: all three GitHub secrets are set (already the case per RISK evidence 0ec29338 R5/R6, confirmed via gh secret list)
test_scenarios.when: the secret-provisioning step runs twice in succession
test_scenarios.then: both runs succeed and `wrangler secret list --name altifyai` shows all three secrets present after each run

test_scenarios.scenario: Token-scope probe emits exactly one named keystroke on a missing Workers AI scope
test_scenarios.given: a mocked Cloudflare API response returning 401/403 for the /ai/run probe (reproducing PR #92's measured live 401)
test_scenarios.then: it emits exactly one ::error:: line in the FR-3 format naming a concrete permission to add, and no other chairman-facing output

test_scenarios.scenario: capture.js's warn-once latch suppresses a second console.error within the same isolate
test_scenarios.given: captureError() is called twice in succession within one isolate with the same missing-env condition, using the existing _resetWarnedMissingEnvForTests() test hook to control latch state
test_scenarios.then: console.error is invoked exactly once (closing the existing TS-9 test gap that only ever called captureError() a single time)

test_scenarios.scenario: composeFailureDetail is unmodified and TS-10/TS-12 continue to pass
test_scenarios.given: the altifyai test suite tests/alt-text-generate.test.js is run unchanged after this SD's FR-4 changes land
test_scenarios.then: both pass exactly as before — failure_detail still carries zero provider message text — proving FR-4's scope reduction did not regress the pinned security tests

test_scenarios.scenario: venture-build-status.mjs's BUILD_STATUS enum is unchanged for every existing fixture
test_scenarios.given: the existing venture-build-status.mjs test fixtures are run before and after the FR-5 additive `cause` field is introduced
test_scenarios.then: every existing fixture's BUILD_STATUS enum value is byte-identical to its pre-change value (additive-only regression guard)

acceptance_criteria: A failed stage-23 journey result row carries captured_cause with provenance (producer, run_id, content_hash) populated from FR-1 for every non-absent leg — the CI-form exit predicate from Solomon c2cba209
The altifyai Deploy run fails when a forwarding secret (EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_URL, EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, or VENTURE_ID) is missing — the second half of Solomon c2cba209's exit predicate
No chairman-facing keyboard packet after merge instructs reading a Cloudflare dashboard or log stream; the only allowed CI-failure surface is the one named keystroke from FR-3

The AltifyAI status line Adam carries (adam-exec-summary.mjs / adam-decision-email.mjs output) shows the captured cause for a venture with a RED stage-23 walk, distinguishing populated / empty-but-succeeded / capture-unavailable states

risks.risk: An 8KB-unbounded or unredacted Worker log capture leaks a secret, API key, or PII fragment into uat_test_results.metadata, which multiple downstream readers (gates, Adam's status line, exec summaries) then propagate
risks.mitigation: TR-2 mandates routing all captured text through the existing allowlist-only redaction pattern before storage, plus the explicit per-leg/total size caps in FR-1; TS-4 tests the size bound and EXEC must add a dedicated redaction-coverage test before this FR is considered complete (per RISK evidence 0ec29338 R2, documented as a hard EXEC-completion gate, not optional)
risks.rollback_plan: Feature is additive (captured_cause is a new, optional metadata field); rollback is reverting the EHG_Engineer PR, which removes the write path with no schema migration to undo

risks.risk: An empty-but-successful capture (item_count=0) is indistinguishable from an absent/failed capture in the rendered status line, so a RED walk with genuinely no matching evidence reads identically to 'the harness never even tried' — silently defeating the SD's purpose of always surfacing a diagnosis
risks.mitigation: The three-state absent/empty/populated render contract (FR-1 AC-2, tested by TS-2/TS-3) makes the two cases textually distinct by construction; DESIGN evidence 1a71cf03 specifies the exact wording for each state
risks.rollback_plan: Rendering logic lives entirely in the pure formatCauseLine() function; a wording regression is fixed forward with no data migration

risks.risk: The walker becomes its own evidence's producer (dispatches the Cloudflare/D1 queries AND authors the provenance that gates read), reproducing the provenance-forgery pattern ratification 6c263823 was written to close
risks.mitigation: content_hash is computed over the actual API response bytes (not a self-asserted claim) using the existing computeDedupHash pattern already used for evidence_hash; run_id is the Cloudflare API's own request/ray id where available, not a walker-generated string; TR-1's injectable-deps design makes the boundary between dispatcher and evidence author auditable in tests
risks.rollback_plan: If provenance is later found insufficiently independent, the acceptance-artifact-gate's existing PROVENANCE_PREDICATES pattern can be extended to validate captured_cause the same way it validates uat_test_runs, without a schema change

risks.risk: EXEC branches the altifyai changes from one of the two stale local checkouts (73-132 commits behind origin/main, one with an unrelated uncommitted feature) instead of a fresh pull, silently reintroducing already-reverted code or conflicting with PRs #90-#94
risks.mitigation: TR-4 explicitly requires branching from a fresh `git fetch origin && git checkout -b <branch> origin/main`; EXEC must state the exact commit SHA branched from in its handoff evidence
risks.rollback_plan: If a stale-base conflict is discovered post-PR, close the PR and re-branch from a fresh origin/main pull; no altifyai production state is affected until the PR merges

phases.description: Implement the three capture functions with injectable deps, the redaction pass, the size bound, and the two-tier storage (per-step metadata + SD-level rollup)
Add formatCauseLine(), the additive venture-build-status.mjs field, and the parent-completion.mjs re-read
deliverables: venture-build-status.mjs additive field + regression test TS-10

phases.description: Wire the existing one-shot-secret-provision.yml loop and one-shot-ai-probe.yml probe shape into deploy.yml as fail-loud steps; flip capture.js to console.error; rewrite the doc
deliverables: capture.js console.error change + TS-8 latch test

phases.description: Confirm both PRs together satisfy the exit predicate end-to-end against a real forced-failure walk
deliverables: EHG_Engineer PR with altifyai PR URL attached as evidence
manual verification run: forced-fail journey -> captured_cause populated -> status line shows cause

technical_decisions: captured_cause is stored as a nested object (not flat keys like authForensics) because it aggregates three independently-provenanced sources rather than one observation stream — DESIGN evidence 1a71cf03 evaluated the flat-20-key alternative and rejected it as worse

FR-2/FR-3 reuse existing shipped altifyai workflow logic (PR #90, #92) rather than authoring new provisioning/probe code, per LEAD's scope-reduction finding that the underlying mechanisms already exist and are tested

FR-4's composeFailureDetail half is cut at LEAD (not reopened at PLAN) because it directly conflicts with pinned security tests TS-10/TS-12 in altifyai; diagnosis for that specific failure path is carried by FR-1's D1 capture instead, which reads the same generated_alt_texts.failure_code/failure_detail data without needing to relax the redaction

consumers.name: Adam (autonomous coordinator role)
consumers.interaction: Reads the cause line via adam-exec-summary.mjs and adam-decision-email.mjs when reviewing venture status; reads captured_cause directly when investigating a RED stage-23 walk
consumers.frequency: Every venture status review cycle and every RED walk

consumers.name: Chairman
consumers.interaction: Receives the cause line embedded in exec summaries / decision emails; never needs to read a Cloudflare dashboard or Worker log directly
consumers.frequency: Whenever a status/decision email is sent for AltifyAI

consumers.name: plan-to-lead prerequisite-check.js and db-sourced-findings.js (existing, unmodified)
consumers.interaction: Continue reading journey_walk_result.status as today; captured_cause is an additive field available to them but not required by this SD's scope
consumers.frequency: Every PLAN-TO-LEAD handoff and quality-findings pass touching a journey-walk SD

dependencies.name: Cloudflare Workers Observability API + D1 HTTP API
dependencies.contract: Read-only HTTP calls credentialed via CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (existing fleet-wide env, same contract as lib/operator/cloudflare-cost-adapter.js)
dependencies.failure_handling: A failed/timed-out call sets that leg's absent=true with absent_reason='fetch_failed'; the walk itself is never blocked by a capture failure

dependencies.name: public.feedback / record_venture_error RPC (existing, unmodified)
dependencies.contract: Read-only query against existing idx_feedback_venture_error_created index; no schema change
dependencies.failure_handling: A query error sets venture_errors.absent=true with absent_reason='fetch_failed'

dependencies.name: rickfelix/altifyai Deploy workflow
dependencies.contract: The EHG_Engineer walker's D1/Observability reads depend on the venture continuing to deploy with the same worker name and D1 database naming convention used to resolve database_id live
dependencies.failure_handling: If the venture's worker/D1 naming changes, queryVentureD1's live resolution fails closed to absent=true rather than querying the wrong venture's data

data_contracts.validation: run_id/content_hash required non-null whenever absent=false; total serialized size bounded ~8KB with a hard backstop
data_contracts.versioning: New field, additive only; no existing reader is required to understand it, so no version negotiation is needed

runtime_config.deployment_considerations: EHG_Engineer half deploys with the normal LEO PR/merge flow. altifyai half deploys via its existing deploy.yml on push to main; the new provisioning/probe steps are additive to that same workflow, so no separate deployment sequencing is required.
